/generate.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with the few-step distilled LoRA.

code_snippets.python:
from gradio_client import Client

client = Client("hugging-apps/moss-image-8-step-dmd")
result = client.predict(
	prompt="Hello!!",
	height=1024,
	width=1024,
	num_steps=8,
	seed=0,
	randomize_seed=True,
	lora_strength=0.7,
	api_name="/generate",
)
print(result)

curl -X POST http://localhost:7860/gradio_api/call/v2/generate -s -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompt": "Hello!!", "height": 1024, "width": 1024, "num_steps": 8, "seed": 0, "randomize_seed": true, "lora_strength": 0.7}' \
  | awk -F'"' '{ print $4}' \
  | read EVENT_ID; curl -N http://localhost:7860/gradio_api/call/generate/$EVENT_ID
